sourceRefs.locator: BK 9, Date and Transmission. Editions by Pertz and Boretius date the edict to 18 October 614. Manuscript Berlin, Staatsbibliothek, Phill. 1743.
No. 9, p. 22, c. 12, and p. 23, final subscription and dating clause. Judges from other provinces or regions, restitution from their own goods, and Paris as the place of issue.
Attestation 1173. Closing clause of the edict of Chlothar II, issue at Paris in 614.

labels.de: Chlothar II. erlässt ein Edikt in Paris
labels.en: Chlothar II issues an edict at Paris

note.de: Die Schlussformel gibt Paris als Ausstellungsort an. Kapitel 12 sieht die Erstattung widerrechtlich entzogener Güter aus dem Besitz des verantwortlichen Richters vor.
note.en: The dating clause gives Paris as the place of issue. Chapter 12 requires restitution from the property of a judge who wrongfully seized goods.
